value.body:
API shape is changing again, confirmation with Jack Heart pending: "there should just be one eval model server that you write and that is maybe wrapped by some sort of Etude server wrapper that does both the model serving and the game playing". Likely: the author writes one server (serve(config) yielding a play(match) callable, holding models and batching), Etude wraps it (start once per machine, concurrent play calls, deadlines, failed+retry, per-match delivery), and EvalJob names that server with no play of its own. Hold the author-facing types (InferenceServer, EvalJob.play/server) until confirmed; keep working on the Etude-side wrapper parts, which this does not change.
